# Model card: score projection

<!-- Generated by `criciq-ml report` from the model registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Version** 1.0.0 · **data** 2026-05-31.713dafe9 · served model trained on 2008-2026 (1,217 complete first innings, 151,080 match states)

## What it does

During a first innings, estimates the distribution of the final total after every ball: the median, an 80% range and the chance of passing any total. Chases are not projected, because a chase stops at its target (the win probability covers them). Outputs are model estimates of historical patterns, not predictions of live matches, and not for betting.

## How it works

- **Target:** the runs still to come, divided by what the scoring era would expect from the balls left (a rolling scoring rate of the competition). One model then stays valid from 2008 to 2026, while average first-innings totals rose by about 30 runs.
- **Model:** LightGBM quantile regression at the 5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 90 and 95% levels. Crossing quantiles are sorted.
- **Calibration:** conformal, per level. Each level is shifted by the matching quantile of its errors on held-out seasons, so that about that share of totals falls below it. The served model is calibrated on out-of-fold predictions for 2025, 2026.
- **P(total ≥ X)** is read off a piecewise-linear CDF through the quantiles. The CDF starts at the current score and ends a little beyond the 95% quantile.
- Rain-shortened innings are excluded from training and evaluation and are not projected.

**Features:** Legal balls bowled; Balls remaining; Wickets lost; Runs above the era's par for this stage; Run rate relative to the era's scoring rate; Runs in the last 12 legal balls; Wickets in the last 12 legal balls.

## Evaluation protocol

- **Tune** on 2021-2022, with candidates trained on seasons up to 2020.
- **Calibrate** on 2023-2024.
- **Test** on 2025-2026, touched once.
- No season does two jobs.

| **CricIQ projection** (conformal) | 80.3% | 54.4 | 16.88 | +5.36 | 4.874 | 0.113 |
| Same model, uncalibrated | 82.2% | 56.5 | 16.68 | +4.07 | 4.811 | 0.112 |
| Par for the era + historical spread | 79.7% | 61.1 | 18.43 | +6.56 | 5.460 | 0.126 |
| TV-style run-rate projection (point only) | n/a | n/a | 27.92 | -7.72 | n/a | n/a |

The Brier score averages P(total ≥ X) for X in 160, 180, 200, 220. Bias is the median minus the actual total; positive means the projection ran high.

## Rolling-origin backtest

For each season *s*: fit on seasons before *s - 2*, calibrate on *s - 2* and *s - 1*, test on *s*. This doubles as the **bias check**, a watch on the drift in scoring across eras.

| Season | Innings | Mean total | 80% coverage | Median error | Par median error | Bias |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2016 | 58 | 162.8 | 79.0% | 14.45 | 15.37 | +1.96 |
| 2017 | 59 | 165.8 | 79.5% | 14.85 | 15.67 | +2.63 |
| 2018 | 58 | 172.4 | 74.3% | 16.54 | 16.85 | -1.65 |
| 2019 | 59 | 168.5 | 78.6% | 15.64 | 16.23 | -2.33 |
| 2020 | 60 | 169.5 | 85.7% | 14.29 | 14.82 | -3.18 |
| 2021 | 60 | 159.3 | 72.9% | 16.57 | 17.30 | +2.23 |
| 2022 | 74 | 171.1 | 79.8% | 15.85 | 16.83 | -4.44 |
| 2023 | 73 | 183.5 | 82.9% | 15.48 | 16.56 | -2.63 |
| 2024 | 70 | 190.1 | 82.2% | 17.21 | 19.19 | +2.07 |
| 2025 | 72 | 191.1 | 83.4% | 15.80 | 18.00 | +4.33 |
| 2026 | 71 | 195.8 | 76.3% | 17.45 | 18.48 | +3.66 |

The projection beats par on median error in 11 of 11 seasons. Bias ranges from -4.4 to +4.3 runs. The scoring-era adjustment keeps it from drifting in one direction, but a single season can run a few runs high or low.

## Feature selection

Each candidate group was added to the served features and scored by rolling origin on 2016-2024, never on the test seasons.

None improved the pinball loss by more than 0.01 runs (well inside year-to-year noise), so the served model leaves them out.

| Variant | Pinball | Median error |
|---|---|---|
| Served features | 4.493 | 15.69 |
| + Batters at the crease (career strike rate, average, balls faced) | 4.530 | 15.85 |
| + Batting still to come (career averages) | 4.501 | 15.79 |
| + Bowling still to come (career economy, 4-over quotas) | 4.492 | 15.62 |
| + Venue scoring index | 4.619 | 15.91 |

## Limitations

- The range is calibrated on average over all balls, so coverage varies by phase: powerplay 77.5%, middle 81.1%, death 82.2% on the test seasons.
- Weather, pitch and team news are not in the data. The model knows the era, not the venue or the day.
- Innings reduced by rain are not projected.
